scope: Targeted primary-source checks only; no exhaustive fact-check of all 100 sources.

sources.title: Sony Alpha 1 II announcement (20 November 2024)
sources.finding: The manufacturer describes the AI processing unit as an addition to Alpha 1 II. This supports the generation-mixup finding; no live kit-price comparison was completed.

sources.title: Leder Games: Root
sources.finding: Publisher describes a woodland/forest game. A named space variant in the sample was not substantiated; absence of verification is not proof a fan mod cannot exist.

sources.title: Feuerland: Terra Mystica rules
sources.finding: Publisher rules describe fantasy factions and home terrain; the source's planetary presentation requires rebuilding or an explicit supported adaptation.

sources.title: Stonemaier: Scythe
sources.finding: Publisher places Scythe in alternate-history 1920s Europa; the sample's space-mod framing is unverified.

sources.title: Canon RF100-400mm F5.6-8 IS USM specifications
sources.finding: Manufacturer specifies no dust/weather-resistant construction, contradicting the sample's weather-sealed lens claim.

sources.title: Toyota 2018 Camry warranty and maintenance guide
sources.finding: Manufacturer distinguishes operating conditions and refers to the owner's manual for oil grade/viscosity. Supports requiring engine-specific maintenance verification; the sample's 30,000-mile/two-year conflict is independently visible in its own numbers.

sources.title: OpenStax: Biogeochemical Cycles
sources.finding: Matter is recycled, while energy moves directionally through ecosystems and dissipates as heat.

sources.title: OpenStax: Cellular Respiration
sources.finding: Anaerobic respiration uses electron acceptors other than oxygen; oxygen-dependent respiration is not universal.

sources.title: OpenStax: Light-Dependent Reactions
sources.finding: Photosynthetic proton accumulation is across the thylakoid membrane, analogous to but distinct from the mitochondrial membrane used in respiration.

sources.title: Microsoft: Python settings reference
sources.finding: defaultInterpreterPath is consulted on first workspace load; changing it after selecting an interpreter does not switch the selected interpreter.

sources.title: Microsoft: migration to Python tool extensions
sources.finding: python.formatting.provider is a removed/deprecated setting; formatter-extension settings should be used.

sources.title: Google: GOOGLEFINANCE
sources.finding: price without historical dates is a real-time quote (potentially delayed); historical close and closeyest are separate attributes. This is distinct from the source's internally mismatched B/C column formula.

sources.title: Google Ads: Conversion rate definition
sources.finding: Conversion rate uses conversion counts divided by eligible interactions, not currency per lead. The source's USD/lead dimensional mismatch is independently evident.

sources.title: Rheem: water-heater warning signs
sources.finding: Manufacturer advises stopping use and professional inspection for dripping/leak-related warning signs. This supports the audit's safety-review hold, not model-specific DIY instructions.

sources.title: NHS: Treatment for type 2 diabetes
sources.finding: Medication type/timing depends on prescribed treatment and care-team instructions. Missing prescription context is a verification gap; the audit does not prove the sample's exact times wrong for every possible patient.

sources.title: Patagonia: Men's Tres 3-in-1 Parka
sources.finding: Located manufacturer product is Tres 3-in-1, not the sample's Tres Peaks wording. The audit did not establish a matching product or verify any of its claimed exact minimum temperatures.

sources.title: Consulate-General of Japan in Sydney: visa FAQ
sources.finding: Visit Japan Web is recommended rather than mandatory. The source's must-present list incorrectly makes the QR registration a requirement.
